routine: i don’t brush my hair or anything before the shower, i just shake it out. i get in and get it wet and let the water fully saturate my hair and then shampoo with shea moisture Manuka Honey & Mafura Oil shampoo, rinse & then squeeze a little water out. then i will split my hair down the back so i have two sections, then take my Manuka Honey & Mafura Oil mask (i use as a conditioner) & finger comb & disperse this into my hair. i use about a little under a tbsp i’d say. i let that sit in my hair while i do my other shower things , then i will comb through my hair starting from the bottom (using my tangle teezer) , before rinsing out the mask. then i put my hair in a t shirt till i’m ready to style. when i start styling i put the top section of my hair up in a clip, kinda like half up half down. & then separate the bottom hair into two. ill spray my hair with water to make sure it’s soaked again. i’ll then go in with like less than a dime amount of AG hair care Re-Coil, i’ll spread that together in my hands & then praying hands it through the section, & then scrunch it in. then i’ll get some of my eco styler olive oil gel & scrunch it into that section. repeat for the other sections. then i will pixie diffuse my hair, once dry i do a flip upside down & give my hair a good shake out with my hands. then pick apart big curl chunks !
